title: crypto SPV management for token deals across Ethereum and MultiversX
content_html:
You have a group of investors and you need to run a special purpose vehicle for a token deal. You may see spreadsheets, emails and many wallets. That makes it hard to know who owns what and when payouts happen.

Track member allocations

Start by adding each member’s wallet address. The tool pulls balances from Ethereum and MultiversX. It then shows a single view of the total allocation. You can see each investor’s share at a glance. This reduces the need for manual calculations.

Set up vesting schedules

Many token deals have vesting periods. You can create a schedule that matches the deal terms. The system will lock the tokens until the vesting date passes. When the date arrives, the tokens become claimable for each investor. This keeps the vesting logic consistent for all members.

Run automated distributions and reports

When a payout event occurs, the platform will calculate each member’s portion. It will then generate a transaction that moves the payout to the correct wallets. After the distribution, a report is created. The report lists who received what and when. Investors can download the report for their records.

  • Add wallets for all members
  • Import the token contract address
  • Define the vesting dates and percentages
  • Trigger a distribution event
  • Export the final report

The workflow lets a syndicate run a token deal without moving funds through a custodial service. All assets stay in the investors’ own wallets. The platform works on any chain that supports smart contracts, so you can add new chains as they launch.

Cryptool currently serves more than 15,000 users. Those users include syndicates and angel groups that need to manage token deals. You might want to check out cryptool if you want a single place to track allocations, vesting and payouts across Ethereum and MultiversX.
